Siya mentioned food, sleep, exercise, cleanliness, and stress.
Siya connected lack of sleep with tiredness and poor hygiene with germs.
Lesson stopped before teach-back was completed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the idea that health includes food, sleep, exercise, cleanliness, and managing stress. Siya gave everyday examples, including tiredness from not sleeping and germs from poor hygiene. The stress example was not fully clarified before the lesson ended. At home, ask Siya to name one healthy habit for each area and explain how it helps.
